_comment: Example lab FortiGate inventory for prisma/seed-lab-fortigates.ts.
COPY THIS OUTSIDE THE CHECKOUT before filling it in — the real file holds
live API tokens and this repository is public. The default location is
Git cannot stage a path outside its own tree, which is the point: there is
no ignore rule to forget and no `git add -A` that can reach it.
Create the token on each gate as a REST API administrator with the
narrowest profile that still covers what you are testing. Read-only is
enough for discovery, monitoring, VIP and DHCP reads; the push, quarantine
and description-sync pathways additionally need device-config write.
Every value in 'defaults' can be overridden per device.
verifySsl defaults to false here because lab gates usually present
self-signed certificates. Production integrations default to verify-ON.
The four write toggles are off. Turn one on for the run that tests it —
these are real devices, and a discovery cycle acts on them.
